objective.primaryRule: No primary and no roles: nothing is searched for selection, ranked or selected (AD1). The study accelerates the GPU evaluator's host pipeline, proves bit-identical results, hardens enforcement and regenerates the acceptance; its outcomes are engineering gates (PROTOCOL.md section 9) and a verdict (section 10).

risk.denominator: one fixed $100,000 principal budget (not peak account equity)

budget.notes: No search proposals for selection. backendEvaluations caps fresh CPU reference pooled simulations on real data (parity references, the CPU baseline of the Assignment 3 job replay, the CPU arm of the parity-only mini-optimization, the sustained run's CPU samples). GPU evaluations (non-official benchmarks, parity runs, sealed-job replays) are counted separately in the records; synthetic fixtures are not counted.

evaluationBackend.justification: Engineering acceptance study (GPU Phase 3): CPU evaluations are parity references and benchmark baselines; GPU evaluations are non-official benchmarks, parity runs and replays of sealed jobs compared by identity. Nothing is official optimization evidence (standard 3.0.0 section 9.8); the study's output is a new acceptance record (section 9.9).

chronologicalConsequence: not applicable: a diagnostic with no search for selection and no chronological verdict (AD2)

deviations.description: no roles and no primary; nothing is selected
deviations.justification: brief: engineering assignment, not trading research; no strategy, fitness or selection change

deviations.description: no official search, no chronological verdict; sealed jobs of Assignments 3 and 2 replayed with their own frozen code and seeds and a parity-only fixed-seed mini-optimization, compared by identity only
deviations.justification: brief §1, §5.2: real production-style optimizer jobs, fixed-seed comparisons

deviations.description: D19-D24 and FULL opened quietly (own door log) for reference identities, sealed-job replays and seeded parity/timing configurations
deviations.justification: brief §5: representative 2016-2026 parity, short and long doors

deviations.description: the CPU engine is the unmodified canonical reference; the GPU result and the new host path must be bit-identical
deviations.justification: brief: same strategy, optimizer, candidates, results; only faster

deviations.description: not applicable: no fold primary or final candidate
host-worker and batch-size measurements are host-path engineering, not a search's tuning benchmark; CPU reference = the 12-worker pool
deviations.justification: brief §1, §2: explicit controls for worker count grounded in measured data

deviations.description: stricter: no money figure of any non-reference configuration; identity booleans, counts, hashes and timings only
deviations.justification: brief: do not use strategy performance as an engineering decision input

deviations.description: one bounded 30-60 min sustained run on the final code instead of a new long endurance test; Phase 2's 8 h run reused only for byte-identical components
deviations.justification: brief §5: the user does not authorize additional 8-hour or 24-hour endurance tests
